name: color_retrieval
description: Retrieve an object's color from short factual context; matched control retrieves the object with that color.
generator_code:
import random,json
random.seed(0)
colors='red blue green yellow black white orange purple pink brown'.split(); objects='ball cup hat car box pen bag chair kite book'.split()
items=[];controls=[]
for i in range(100):
 cs=random.sample(colors,3);os=random.sample(objects,3);j=random.randrange(3)
 stem=' '.join(f'The {o} is {c}.' for o,c in zip(os,cs))+'\n'
 items.append({'prompt':stem+f'Question: What color is the {os[j]}?\nAnswer:','answer':' '+cs[j]})
 controls.append({'prompt':stem+f'Question: Which object is {cs[j]}?\nAnswer:','answer':' '+os[j]})
json.dump({'items':items,'control':controls},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
